comment: Camera bookmarks for demo/city.tscn. target = ground point (WGS84 degrees); the camera looks along heading (degrees from north, clockwise) and pitch (degrees, negative = down) at the point target_height metres above that ground, from distance metres away. Positions come from OpenStreetMap (via Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0). No military sites. check = one of the reference views used for visual checks.
